_doc: Copy this file to harness.config.local.json to override the default config (gitignored). Use this to fill in your API key for LLM mode.

gemini._doc: Gemini CLI: registers an AfterAgent hook.

claude._doc: Claude Code: registers a Stop hook.

codex._doc: Codex CLI: only global scope is supported.

_state_dir_doc: Where per-session audit state lives. Falls back to <cwd>/.harness/state/. Set to e.g. ~/.harness/state/ for global.

audit._mode_doc: regex (default) = local parseable self-review format | llm = semantic judge
audit._dry_run_doc: When true, harness logs decisions to stderr and exits 0 without blocking. Use for testing.

llm_config._providers_doc: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions), vLLM, LocalAI.

kiro._auto_configure_doc: When true, install.cjs will also write chatgpt.cliExecutable to ~/.config/Kiro/User/settings.json so Kiro reuses Codex CLI. Off by default — opt-in to avoid surprise side effects.
